name: autocomplete_search
description: Retrieves search autocomplete suggestions for a query on Carrefour France. Returns a list of suggested search terms with their highlighted text, plain text, and corresponding search links. Useful for powering a search bar autocomplete/typeahead feature.

q.description: The search query string to get autocomplete suggestions for. Can be empty or partial text typed by the user.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of autocomplete suggestions to return.

productCard.description: Whether to include product card data in the suggestions response.
